title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East (Early Show) on 1970-01-03
lineage: Dat (Sony R500) > Sound Devices 744T > Samplitude Pro X3 Suite > FLAC/

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording that benefits from a little EQ work but captures an energetic show with standout Bob Weir playing and the usual Dead spirit.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rate this performance four stars, praising its high energy and “genius moments,” especially noting Bob Weir’s excellent playing. The soundboard mix is generally solid yet requires bass‑boost and treble reduction to tame wide volume swings and a surprisingly low presence of Jerry Garcia's guitar. Overall the show is regarded as a good representation of the Dead’s improvisational power.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is praised while recording needs EQ adjustments; with 70% weight to performance and 30% to audio, the combined assessment lands at a solid four‑star level.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mix is clear but dynamic range is wide; listeners should raise bass and lower treble. Garcia's guitar is low in the mix while Bob Weir is prominent.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers describe the concert as an energetic, cohesive performance that captures the band’s improvisational spirit.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Mix places his guitar low; however reviewers note he leads the show with classic Dead energy.
band_member_comments.Bob: Prominent and playing excellently; highlighted as a strong point of the performance.
